title: With A Seat This Hard,  Who Needs a Chair?
text:
With A Seat This Hard, Who Needs a Chair?. This modern looking chair LOOKS comfortable, but it is not. It appears as if the seat is soft, but I sat on this and practically bounced off, it was so hard. Plus, this is geared for a taller person, someone whose back will come right to the back of the chair.

If you are not tall, a pillow for your back would help. And, again, what is with the hard seat? The legs appear spindly, and I can't be sure they would support a few-hundred pound person.

The chair may be best for an office, but I will tell you, the seat will be the first thing someone notices. So, all around, this is not comfortable, whether you place it in your office, or your home office. I doubt anyone will want to sit in it for long.

◕◕ .. If you use this for the office, where you have customers/visitors, they might want out of the office quickly, if they have to sit on this chair. If you have someone to visit and need to get rid of them quickly, let them sit in this chair. I guarantee, they will leave quickly.

product_metadata.title: Adesso Kendrick Chair, Charcoal Grey
description: An open, reclined shape with thin, brushed steel legs, the Kendrick chair lightens up contemporary style with airy ambiance. Smooth clean lines are both modern and industrial. The beauty of this collection lies in its simplicity. Rich texture in a woven charcoal grey 100% polyester fabric provides an interesting variation to the sleek, smooth steel base. A weight capacity of 350 pounds is recommended for this item. With an interior seat width of 22. 5", a seat depth of 21", and seat back height of19. 5", the Kendrick Chair is a spacious and cozy option. Overall dimenstions are 33"W x 30. 5"D x 37"H.
